intro: This Algorithm Theoretical Basis Document (ATBD) comprehensively describes the production of the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service Protected Areas 2021 Land Cover/Land Use dataset for terrestrial Natura 2000 sites across the EU27. It details the innovative semi-automatic methodology, integrating super-resolved Sentinel-2 time series with Deep Learning models tailored to biogeographical regions. The document outlines the rigorous reference data strategy, advanced post-processing, and manual refinement procedures, ensuring the final product meets stringent thematic and geometric accuracy targets crucial for biodiversity conservation monitoring and policy evaluation.
